No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । नेपाल प्रिमियर लिग (एनपीएल) को तेस्रो संस्करणमा जनकपुर बोल्ट्सले दुई पाकिस्तानी खेलाडीको स्थानमा बंगलादेशका सैफ हसन र परभेज हुसेन इमोनलाई अनुबन्ध गरेको छ । यी दुवै खेलाडी बंगलादेशको राष्ट्रिय टोलीबाट अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय क्रिकेट खेलिसकेका अनुभवी हुन् । पाकिस्तान क्रिकेट बोर्डबाट आवश्यक अनुमति नपाएपछि जनकपुरका इफ्तिखार अहमद र हुनेन शाह स्वदेश फर्किँदैछन् । उनीहरूको अनुपस्थितिले टोलीको रणनीतिमा असर परेको जनकपुरले जनाएको थियो । त्यसपछि टोलीले वैकल्पिक खेलाडीको व्यवस्था गरेको हो । सैफ हसन : अनुभव र अलराउन्ड क्षमता २७ वर्षीय सैफ हसन दायाँहाते ब्याटर हुन् । आवश्यक पर्दा अफ स्पिनसमेत गर्न सक्ने भएकाले उनी ब्याटिङका अतिरिक्त बलिङको विकल्प पनि हुन सक्छन् । सैफले सन् २०२० मा पाकिस्तानविरुद्धको टेस्टबाट अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय क्रिकेटमा डेब्यू गरेका थिए । त्यसयता उनले बंगलादेशका लागि टेस्ट, एकदिवसीय र टी-२० अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय तीनै प्रारूपमा खेलिसकेका छन् । अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय टी-२० मा उनको प्रदर्शन हेर्दा उनी आक्रामक ब्याटिङमा अझै आफूलाई प्रमाणित गर्ने चरणमा छन् । आईसीसीको उपलब्ध तथ्यांकअनुसार सैफले ३१ टी-२० अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय खेलमा ६२९ रन बनाएका छन् । उनको औसत २३.३० र स्ट्राइक रेट ११६.४८ छ । यस प्रारूपमा उनको उच्चतम स्कोर ६९ रन हो । उनले पाँच अर्धशतक बनाएका छन् । एकदिवसीय अन्तर्राष्ट्रियमा भने उनले १५ खेलमा ३६९ रन बनाएका छन् । उनको औसत २४.६० र उच्चतम स्कोर ८० रन छ । यी तथ्यांकले सैफलाई स्थापित अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय अनुभव भएको ब्याटरका रूपमा चिनाउँछन् । तर, उनको टी-२० अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय स्ट्राइक रेट हेर्दा उनलाई विशुद्ध विस्फोटक ब्याटरभन्दा पनि इनिङ्स सम्हाल्न र आवश्यकताअनुसार गति बढाउन सक्ने खेलाडीका रूपमा हेर्नु उचित हुन्छ । सैफको अर्को पक्ष उनको घरेलु क्रिकेटको अनुभव हो । उनी बंगलादेशको उमेर समूहदेखि सिनियर टोलीसम्म पुगेका खेलाडी हुन् । प्रथम श्रेणी क्रिकेटमा दोहोरो शतक बनाउने सबैभन्दा कान्छा बंगलादेशी खेलाडीमध्ये एकका रूपमा पनि उनी चर्चित छन् । जनकपुरका लागि उनको उपयोगिता ब्याटिङको माथिल्लो क्रममा हुन सक्छ । सुरुवाती विकेट छिटो गुमेको अवस्थामा इनिङ्स सम्हाल्ने र सेट भएपछि रन गति बढाउने जिम्मेवारी उनले लिन सक्छन् । इमोन : छिटो रन बनाउन सक्ने बायाँहाते ब्याटर जनकपुरले भित्र्याएका अर्का खेलाडी परभेज हुसेन इमोन २४ वर्षीय बायाँहाते ब्याटर हुन् । उनी आक्रामक ब्याटिङका लागि परिचित छन् । इमोनले सन् २०२० मा बंगलादेशको यू-१९ विश्वकप जित्ने टोलीमा स्थान बनाएका थिए । उमेर समूहको सफलतापछि उनले राष्ट्रिय टोलीमा पनि स्थान बनाए । इमोनको सबैभन्दा उल्लेखनीय उपलब्धि सन् २०२५ मा संयुक्त अरब इमिरेट्स (यूएई) विरुद्धको टी-२० अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय खेलमा बनाएको शतक हो । उनले उक्त खेलमा केवल ४२ बलमा शतक पूरा गरेका थिए । छोटो प्रारूपमा तीव्र गतिमा रन बनाउन सक्ने उनको क्षमताको यो बलियो प्रमाण हो । आईसीसीको उपलब्ध तथ्यांकअनुसार इमोनले ४० टी-२० अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय लिग (पीएसएल) मा लाहोर कलन्दर्ससँग आबद्ध भएर खेलेका थिए । जनकपुरले इमोनलाई सुरुवाती वा माथिल्लो क्रममा उपयोग गर्न सक्छ । जनकपुर बोल्ट्सले सन् २०२४ मा पहिलो संस्करणको उपाधि जितेको थियो । तेस्रो Janakpur Bolts have signed Bangladeshi Saif Hasan and Parvez Hussain Emon in place of two Pakistani players in the third edition of the Nepal Premier League (NPL). Both of these players are experienced international cricketers who have played for the Bangladesh national team. Janakpur's Iftikhar Ahmed and Hunan Shah are returning home after not receiving the necessary permission from the Pakistan Cricket Board. Janakpur had stated that their absence had affected the team's strategy. The team has since arranged for alternate players. Saif Hassan: Experience and all-round ability Saif Hasan, 27, is a right-handed batsman. He can also be an option for bowling in addition to batting, as he can also spin off when needed. Saif made his international cricket debut in a Test against Pakistan in 2020. Since then, he has played for Bangladesh in all three formats - Tests, ODIs, and T20 Internationals. Judging by his performance in T20 Internationals, he is still in the process of proving himself as an aggressive batsman. According to the available ICC data, Saif has scored 629 runs in 31 T20 Internationals. His average is 23.30 and strike rate is 116.48. His highest score in this format is 69 runs. He has scored five half-centuries. In One Day Internationals, he has scored 369 runs in 15 matches. His average is 24.60 and his highest score is 80 runs. These figures identify Saif as a batsman with established international experience. However, his T20 International strike rate suggests that he is more of a player who can handle the innings and increase pace as needed, rather than a purely explosive batsman. Another aspect of Saif is his experience in domestic cricket. He is a player who has reached the Bangladeshi age group and senior team. He is also famous for being one of the youngest Bangladeshi players to score a double century in first-class cricket. His usefulness for Janakpur could lie in the top order of the batting order. He can take on the responsibility of managing the innings when early wickets are lost quickly and increasing the run rate once things are set. Eamon: A left-handed batter who can score runs quickly. Another player brought in by Janakpur is Parvez Hussain Emon, a 24-year-old left-handed batter known for his aggressive batting. Eamon made it to Bangladesh's U-19 World Cup winning team in 2020. Following his age group success, he also made it to the national team. Eamon's most notable achievement was his century in a T20 International match against the United Arab Emirates (UAE) in 2025. He reached the century in just 42 balls in that match. This is a strong testament to his ability to score runs at a rapid pace in the shorter formats. According to the ICC's data, Eamon has scored 733 runs in 40 T20 Internationals. His average is 19.29 and strike rate is 124.87. In this format, he has scored one century and three half-centuries. In One Day Internationals, he has scored 178 runs in four matches. He played for Lahore Qalandars in the Pakistan Super League (PSL). Janakpur can use Emon in the starting or upper order. Janakpur Bolts won the first edition title in 2024. Janakpur, which is aiming to build a strong team in the third edition as well, has been troubled by the uncertainty of the Pakistani players. In the first match against Karnali Yaks, Janakpur lost by 19 runs. Chasing a target of 133 runs, Janakpur was bundled out for 113 runs in 19.3 overs. The team's batters were not able to score the expected runs in that match.

सफलतापछि उनले राष्ट्रिय टोलीमा पनि स्थान बनाए । इमोनको सबैभन्दा उल्लेखनीय उपलब्धि सन् २०२५ मा संयुक्त अरब इमिरेट्स (यूएई) विरुद्धको टी-२० अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय खेलमा बनाएको शतक हो । उनले उक्त खेलमा केवल ४२
